editorial:
Imagine a quiet, boring neighborhood where nothing ever happens until two gorgeous women, Kirsten and Leslie, move in next door. You can tell right away that these two are not here to just garden or bake pies. They bring a huge burst of energy and mischief to the sleepy suburbs, and it does not take long for every husband on the block to lose their minds over them. It is a lighthearted, cheeky flick that does not take itself too seriously, focusing more on the fun and the flirting than any deep plot. You will find yourself laughing at the awkwardness of the local men as they try to play it cool while failing miserably.

While the acting is a bit over-the-top, it actually fits the campy vibe of the late seventies perfectly. The pacing stays breezy, so you never feel bored, though some of the jokes feel a bit dated. If you love old-school sex comedies that are all about charm and chaos, you will have a blast. You should definitely try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see those vintage colors pop, or if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great call for a rainy weekend movie night.
endingExplained: The movie wraps up with a big, messy showdown where all the husbands finally realize they have been played. After a series of funny confrontations, Kirsten and Leslie reveal that they enjoyed stirring up trouble more than the actual romance. They end up leaving the neighborhood just as quickly as they arrived, leaving the men to face their angry wives. It ends on a high note, showing that the girls won the game.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves vintage sex comedies and campy humor.
